data.title: Anantara Mina Ras Al Khaimah Residences
data.about:
Anantara Mina Ras Al Khaimah Residences is a beachfront branded development by RAK Properties. Located on the pristine shores of Hayat Island, within Mina Al Arab, Ras Al Khaimah, the project introduces a limited collection of suites, 1, 2 and 3-bedroom apartments and duplexes as well as spacious 3, 4 and 5-bedroom private villas.

These elegantly crafted residences embody Anantara’s signature Thai-inspired hospitality blended with Arabian charm. All homes are thoughtfully designed with floor-to-ceiling windows that frame uninterrupted views of the Arabian Gulf.

With lush green spaces, protected mangroves, designer retail, and gourmet dining all within reach, Anantara Mina offers a serene yet sophisticated lifestyle just 45 minutes from Dubai — making it one of the most coveted beachfront addresses in the Northern Emirates.

characteristics_module.title: Anantara Branded Residences Overlooking the Arabian Gulf
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Branded Residences by Anantara: Managed by the globally renowned Anantara Hotels & Resorts, offering five-star hospitality and service.
  • Exclusive Waterfront Location: Situated on Hayat Island within the prestigious Mina Peninsula, with direct sea views and beach access.
  • Spacious, Luxury-Focused Residences: A curated collection of suites, apartments, sky villas, and waterfront villas ranging from 768 to 6,186 sq. ft.
  • Private Infinity Pools & Boat Docks (Villas): Select villas come with their own private garden, infinity pool, and individual boat dock.
  • Access to World-Class Amenities: Including Anantara Spa, yoga studio, cinema, resort-style pools, and a private beach.

location_tile.title: An Idyllic Waterfront Location with Unmatched Connectivity – Live in the Heart of Mina Al Arab
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Nestled in the prestigious Mina Al Arab, Ras Al Khaimah, Anantara Branded Residences offers an exclusive waterfront lifestyle with breathtaking views of the Arabian Gulf. Surrounded by protected mangrove reserves, a flamingo sanctuary, and vibrant marine life, this location embodies serenity and natural beauty. Strategically positioned, the residences provide easy access to Ras Al Khaimah's city center, shopping districts, and major highways while just a short drive from Dubai, offering both luxury and seamless connectivity.

  • 05 Minutes to InterContinental Mina Al Arab
  • 07 Minutes to Al Naeem Mall
  • 11 Minutes to RAK Mall
  • 12 Minutes to RAK Hospital
  • 25 Minutes to Ras Al Khaimah International Airport
  • 30 Minutes to Dhayah Fort
